|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Either Way, You Win (V)]] (version 3 of 3). It is the current text. Each version is the Players Committee's own card image, quoted in full with its upload date; the image on each page is that version's image as published (unchanged). The PC card data (swccg-card-json) is cited as dating evidence only.
* '''Original''' ([[Either Way, You Win (V)]]): the card image at official release (18 June 2023)<ref name="ht-04fafe9">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/04fafe9a4fc2c8a87e045ba98e3a4c685106d50c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/eitherwayyouwin.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/eitherwayyouwin.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/04fafe9a4fc2c8a87e045ba98e3a4c685106d50c 04fafe9] “Set 21 plus stuff”, 18 June 2023.</ref> prints: “If [Tatooine] or [Coruscant] Qui-Gon in battle, he is power +1 for each ‘credit.’ OR Once per game, if a battle just initiated at Watto’s Junkyard involving Qui-Gon, target a character. Lightsabers may not be fired this battle. Unless target is Watto or a Dark Jedi, cancel target’s game text.”<ref name="cj-1ad7bd9">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/1ad7bd9 swccg-card-json commit 1ad7bd9] “all of the LS V21 cards” (17 June 2023) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Either Way, You Win (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023)<ref name="sheet21-20230617">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition] (PDF, 8 pages, footer “”; file created 17 June 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 21]] (18 June 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, page 7, file created 17 June 2023: “If [Tatooine] or [Coruscant] Qui-Gon in battle, he is power +1 for each 'credit.' OR Once per game, if a battle just initiated at Watto's Junkyard involving Qui-Gon, target a character. Lightsabers may not be fired this battle. Unless target is Watto or a Dark Jedi, cancel target's game text.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Either Way, You Win (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Either Way, You Win”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Either Way, You Win (V)]] (published 18 June 2023) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Either Way, You Win]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). The PDF was created on 17 June 2023, the day before the set's release (18 June 2023); the sheet was published with the set, so the slip is placed after the card image in place at release. '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the errata card image (7 March 2026, for the PC's 2026 errata (“Tweak Set 2026”))<ref name="ht-e02f932">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e02f932ae2c407c7c4f2e22fe565a8a64afd742b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/eitherwayyouwin.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/eitherwayyouwin.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e02f932ae2c407c7c4f2e22fe565a8a64afd742b e02f932] “LS Errata”, 7 March 2026, for the PC's 2026 errata (“Tweak Set 2026”).</ref> prints: “Each player may choose to play a Defensive Shield from under their Starting Effect or to exchange a card in hand with one of their race destinies. [Immune to Sense] OR If a battle involving Qui-Gon was just initiated at a junkyard, weapons may not be fired this battle.”<ref name="cj-4a981d6">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/4a981d6 swccg-card-json commit 4a981d6] “Light - Tweak Set 2026” (15 March 2026) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' The whole text was replaced. Both old options (Qui-Gon power +1 for each ‘credit’, and the once-per-game Watto’s Junkyard option that stopped lightsabers and canceled a target’s game text) were removed. The new text is “Each player may choose to play a Defensive Shield from under their Starting Effect or to exchange a card in hand with one of their race destinies. [Immune to Sense] OR If a battle involving Qui-Gon was just initiated at a junkyard, weapons may not be fired this battle.” The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.

* (First function) Remember that a Podrace may end in any move phase. Using this Interrupt, there is a clear opportunity to cause a Podrace to end in Light's move phase, which is otherwise quite rare.
